name: @plotday/calendar-webhook
env_vars: SUPABASE_URL SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY SENTRY_DSN SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN SENTRY_ORG SENTRY_PROJECT CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID GOOGLE_OAUTH_SECRET MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID MICROSOFT_OAUTH_SECRET

scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:config && pnpm run dev:start
scripts.deploy: export RELEASE=$GITHUB_SHA $(pnpm --silent gen-env) && pnpm build && pnpm source-map && wrangler deploy --var $(pnpm --silent deploy-vars) --env ${DEPLOY_ENV:-production} --no-bundle --node-compat false build/index.js
scripts.source-map: export $(pnpm --silent gen-env) && sentry-cli sourcemaps inject build && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --release=$RELEASE --dist=calendar-webhook build
